race.comment: GENESIS RUNNER (1) drifted back early second up and like the way he closed late returning good figures when fourth in the G3 Ming Dynasty Quality at Rosehill over 1400m. Blinkers go on from the good gate and will take stopping over the extra ground. SAVAGRAM (2) engaged in a speed duel early and paid the price late with a tiring seventh over 1400m in the G3 Ming Dynasty Quality. Can take control early and expect a much better performance over this trip. WONKA (4) fourth up for this and maps to stalk the speed in a harder contest. Worth thought. YOUR COLOUR (10) improving Maurice filly who bounced back with a determined Maiden victory over 1400m at Newcastle. Sharp rise in grade and not to be underestimated at the good odds. HOZUMI (5) well bred gelding who made rapid improvement at his second race start with a strong Maiden victory from back in the field over 1450m at Illawarra Grange. Don't dismiss.
